g.text: signs the vault and the mint

svg.text: one position per (pool, owner, side): the seeds are the cap, and the
entry snapshot is what makes settlement account-local — closing or
liquidating one position touches that position and the pool, never a third
reserved_liquidity is the LPs’ promise to the winners: an LP can never
withdraw it, and profit on a close is capped at the size it reserved
the vault mixes custody; the three ledger fields keep the ownership straight:
the vault balance is always liquidity + total_collateral + protocol_fees
per-side scaled accumulators price the whole book
in two multiplications, so solvency, AUM and LP
share pricing never iterate the open positions
